tagline: KDE Plasma Mobile on the iPad GPU
description:
**xios-kde** installs the KDE Plasma Mobile desktop for Xios: the Plasma Mobile shell on KWin, rendered on the iPad GPU through the iosc compositor and ANGLE.

This one package pulls in the Qt 6 runtime, the KDE Frameworks 6 subset Plasma needs, KWin, and the Breeze icons and style.

After it installs, open the Xios app and the Plasma session starts. Plasma Mobile is built for touch first, so it is a natural fit for the iPad.

Requires iOS 16.0+.

changelog.notes: - First release: Plasma Mobile + KWin + Qt 6 + KDE Frameworks 6 as one install
